The '''House of Jarvinen''' is the royal dynasty associated with [[Imperial Suomi]]. Old source material gives King Jarvinen I as the monarch under whom the Suomi state was established in 1652.

== Historical Role ==

The dynasty gives Suomi its long constitutional continuity. King Jarvinen I anchors the 1652 founding period, while Jarvinen X is associated with the 1958 restructuring that made Suomi a constitutional monarchy.

The extracted source does not provide a full succession list, regnal chronology, or internal family politics. This draft therefore keeps the dynasty as a bridge page until a dedicated Suomi monarchy pass can decide which monarchs need full articles.

== Constitutional Position ==

By the 1994-back window, the House of Jarvinen should be treated as a constitutional royal house rather than an unlimited personal monarchy. The source's 1958 restructuring implies that royal authority had been limited by formal political institutions.
